text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few weekends after that surprise recruitment on a deserted island
led to me becoming Hishi Akebono's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, look at that nice color~! Looks delicious♪
—Wait, I'm not supposed to pick too much from one spot!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll check out the next mountain over!
Come on, Trainer, hurry, hurry~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It all started a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wanna go on an outing this weekend if you're free?
I wanna go gather some ingredients to make chanko nabe~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Going together with my trainer was always a dream of mine~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I assumed we'd be heading to her recommended greengrocer or fish market.
That guess was completely shattered, and before I knew it, we were mushroom hunting in the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alrighty, that should do it~! Let's head for the ocean next~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hiking across five whole mountains, our carrying basket was overflowing with wild herbs and mushrooms.
I gave it a try and attempted to lift it, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! We gathered so much, it's gotta be pretty heavy~!
Leave the carrying to me~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Hup, two, three, hoist☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With those words, Hishi Akebono effortlessly lifted the seemingly immovable basket and dashed off with boundless energy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Take thaaat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Caught a huge sea bass! Trainer, could you keep an eye on the cooler, please?
There are lots of kitties around here~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah! Spotted an eeeven bigger fish~! Be right baaack!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident A
text_block_list.text: Wait... hold on, did that girl just catch a sea bass with her bare hands?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yay~! Caught an even bigger one!

text_block_list.name: Local Resident B
text_block_list.text:
No way, you're seeing things—wait... what...?
She really is... she's catching sea bass with her bare hands...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, we sprinted from mountain peaks to the seaside, gathering a massive hoard of ingredients.
Utterly exhausted, I was just about to suggest calling it a day, when—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head to the butcher shop next~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup! There's a butcher that sells the most amazing minced chicken,
it's an absolute must-have for chanko nabe~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's a little far out, but the scenery along the way is super pretty and wonderful~!
So with that said, off we go~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite already traveling countless miles today, Hishi Akebono took off running at full tilt.
Her broad back rapidly shrank into the distance.
choice_data_list: (Just how tough can one girl be?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After transferring trains for about an hour, we finally arrived in the remote countryside.
However... that was when a chain of misfortunes struck!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The air out here is so delicious.
Wait, huh? A wild boar...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oink!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It's a boar! So cute~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Wait, huh? Is it charging right at us...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RUMBLE RUMBLE RUMBLE)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eep?! W-W-Whoa~!
Trainer, look out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frozen in shock, I reacted a moment too late.
I scrambled out of the way, but lost my balance—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knocking over the basket brimming with all our gathered ingredients,
I tumbled straight into the river...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Are you okay?! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, I wasn't hurt, but every single ingredient Hishi Akebono had run all over to gather was washed away down the river...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, don't be! Your safety is way more important, Trainer.
Besides, we can definitely still buy meat, so it's all good, all good~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh dear~! Temporarily closed...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And to make matters worse—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The last bus already left!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So early~. Did they replace the timetable?
It's totally different from when we got off. I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... the first bus tomorrow is at 6 AM.
Which means... twelve hours to go~. Oh boy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I couldn't possibly let her sleep out in the open. I explained the situation to the academy and scrambled to find lodging, but came up empty-handed—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Guess we're camping out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Losing all the ingredients we worked so hard to collect, stranded in the boonies with nowhere to sleep...
Even the tough Hishi Akebono had to feel crushed. Or so I thought—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh well, days like this happen! Oh, that's right! The rice and canned food I packed are totally fine, so let's make seasoned rice and eat☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it's not every day you get to camp out in the wild, so it's kinda exciting♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Whoa! Look, look, Trainer! What a gorgeous starry sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without a trace of exhaustion or sadness on her face, Hishi Akebono hopped up and down with a bright smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following her outstretched arm, the starry sky above was indeed breathtakingly beautiful.
